about: The core's licence audit (floor rule 10): what its own workflows and scripts use, held to the tools' list by scripts/licences.mjs with .github/licences.json, which the core's tests workflow runs. Nothing of the core ships. A project's scan leaves its copy of the core out, since this audit holds it; its own uses of the same actions are in its own audit. The scan's own script and test are left out of the scan, since they name the forms it looks for.

entries.name: actions/setup-node
entries.used: the workflows that run a script, on the core's one Node

entries.name: actions/download-artifact
entries.used: preview.yml, the site a pull request's build uploaded

entries.name: actions/dependency-review-action
entries.used: licences.yml, the licence gate on new and updated packages

entries.name: GitHub's commit signing key
entries.used: personal-terms.yml fetches GitHub's public key (https://github.com/web-flow.gpg) to check that a merge was signed by GitHub, which floor rule 11's exception asks: a GitHub service, nothing of which ships

entries.name: Betterleaks
entries.used: personal-terms.yml, which matches the terms with it (#579), and scripts/test-downloads.sh, which the tests workflow's set-up step runs to fetch its Linux x64 archive at the same version and SHA-256 for the tests of that check (#772): the release its maker publishes on GitHub for the machine's system, fetched by the job's own step before any term is read, the archive and the program in it each checked against the SHA-256 written in that file (the archive's as the release's checksums.txt publishes it) and the program again before it runs; its LICENSE, beside it in each archive, is MIT, read on 20 November 2026, and nothing of it ships

entries.name: lychee
entries.used: the pointer check (scripts/pointers.mjs, scripts/links.mjs; #582), which reads the rule files' Markdown links and the headings they name with it, offline: the release its maker publishes on GitHub for the machine's system, fetched by scripts/lychee.sh in the job's set-up, the archive and the program in it each checked against the SHA-256 written in that file (the archive's as the release publishes it), and run on the runners alone, never in a session; nothing of it ships

entries.name: zizmor
entries.used: scripts/test-downloads.sh also fetches its wheel, for the tests that run with the network cut off (#772). the workflow check (scripts/workflows.mjs, scripts/workflow-tools.mjs; #580), which audits each workflow and action with it: its wheel for the machine's system, which .packages/requirements.txt names by version and SHA-256, installed by scripts/workflow-tools.sh with pip, no dependency and none of its code run, into the runner's temporary folder in the job's set-up, and run there alone, never in a session; a tool that only runs, nothing of which ships

entries.name: actionlint
entries.used: the workflow check (scripts/workflows.mjs, scripts/workflow-tools.mjs; #580), which reads each workflow with it: the release its maker publishes on GitHub for the machine's system, fetched by scripts/workflow-tools.sh in the job's set-up, the archive and the program in it each checked against the SHA-256 written there, and run on the runners alone, never in a session; a tool that only runs, nothing of which ships

entries.name: CodeQL CLI
entries.used: code scanning, run by github/codeql-action: a GitHub service, free while a repository is public

entries.name: GitHub CLI
entries.used: gh in versions.yml, core-moved.yml (through scripts/core-moved.mjs), delete-merged-branches.yml and preview.yml, the runner's own

entries.name: jq
entries.used: versions.yml, the runner's own: it reads the issues the versions check would open; and tests/core-moved-test.mjs, which runs through it the expression gh is handed

entries.name: Node.js
entries.used: every script: the core's one exact Node, .node-version (the version here moves with it, as the licence scan's pin of a download asks), which scripts/node.sh fetches as the node-linux-x64 or node-linux-arm64 package (npm pack, or curl from the registry with no npm) and checks by its sum where a machine's own Node is below the least long-term line, .node-least, on which the core's suites run too

entries.name: The core's licence and notice
entries.used: the licence the core is given under, the Apache License 2.0's own text copied whole, and its notice, the work's name and copyright line (README.md, "Licence"; #257): they carry the notice they are, and nothing of the core ships

entries.name: Semgrep's engine
entries.used: scripts/test-downloads.sh also fetches its wheels, for the tests that run with the network cut off (#772; #1074). scripts/code-scan.mjs, the code scan of a private project (#546): semgrep-core and the libraries beside it, from the semgrep wheel for each system, which requirements.txt names by version and SHA-256 and scripts/install.mjs pypi installs with pip, no dependency and none of its code run, in the scan's own step (#654); run as osemgrep with no Python; a tool that only runs, nothing of which ships, so floor rule 10 allows its LGPL. Its rules are the core's own (scripts/code-scan.yml); none of Semgrep's rules, under the Semgrep Rules License, or Opengrep's, under the Commons Clause, is taken. The licence check reads no requirements file, so this entry holds it. Its wheels' PyPI attestation is published by GitHub, semgrep/semgrep-proprietary, workflow pro-release.yml, at 1.185.0, the baseline an update is held to (floor rule 7)

entries.name: npm
entries.used: bundled with Node: npm view in versions.mjs, npm pack in node.sh, npm ci and npm audit signatures in signatures.yml, npm ci in scripts/install.mjs, and npm audit signatures on the core's own packages in tests.yml. At 11.15.0, the least npm the signature check reads whole (scripts/npm-reads.mjs), which its mend installs, with its own bundled packages and no install script, into a folder of its own where a machine's npm is older (scripts/checks.mjs; tests/npm-mend-test.mjs installs it so, and no other version; #1262)
